title: Bad Checks
grade_or_penalty: 2nd degree $75,000+; 3rd degree $1,000 to under $75,000; 4th degree $200 to under $1,000; disorderly persons under $200
key_points: Issuing or passing a check knowing it will not be honored.
Knowledge is presumed if there is no account, or if the check is not paid within 10 days after notice of dishonor.
elements: The suspect issued or passed a check or similar sight order for payment of money
Knowing it would not be honored by the drawee
Check presumptions: no account, or not paid within 10 days after notice of dishonor

subsections.label: Offense
subsections.text: Issues or passes a check or similar sight order knowing it will not be honored

subsections.label: Presumptions
subsections.text: Knowledge presumed if no account existed, or the check is not paid within 10 days after notice of dishonor
